summary_en: 35,000 shares (0.32% S/O), ¥106.2M, ToSTNeT-3, 2026-08-17 settlement. Execution price ¥3,035/share (day's close inclusive of post-market). Single trading window order only.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-auction purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS filed notice on 14 August 2026 of a single-tranche off-auction share buyback (ToSTNeT-3) to be executed on 17 August 2026 at 8:45 a.m. JST. The block comprises 35,000 shares (0.32% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at an execution price of ¥3,035 per share, matching the closing price (including post-market quotation) of 14 August 2026, for an aggregate outlay of ¥106.225 million. The order is time-limited to the single designated trading window; partial or no execution is possible depending on market conditions. This block transaction is undertaken within a broader authorization approved by the Board on 10 August 2026 permitting acquisition of up to 190,000 shares (1.74% S/O) for up to ¥500 million via open-market purchase (including ToSTNeT-3) over the period 17 August to 31 December 2026.
